name: Sales
description: Business domain covering how Adventure Works Cycles sells its bicycles, components and accessories to individual consumers and reseller stores: customers, orders, sales staff and territories, discounts, taxes, currencies and payment cards.

name: Sales Order
description: A customer's request to buy products from Adventure Works. It records the general order information: when it was placed, due and shipped, the customer and the sales person involved, the sales territory, the billing and shipping addresses, the shipping method, the payment card, the currency rate applied and the order totals.

name: Sales Order Line
description: An individual product, in a given quantity at a given price, that is part of a specific sales order. Each line may be priced under a special offer.

name: Customer
description: A person or a reseller store that purchases Adventure Works products. Individual customers buy online; store customers are resellers. A customer is assigned to a sales territory.

name: Reseller Store
description: A retail business that resells Adventure Works products and is a customer of the company. A store is looked after by a sales person and has addresses, contacts and demographic information.

name: Sales Person
description: An employee who sells Adventure Works products. The sales person's current information includes the assigned sales territory, sales quota, commission and year-to-date and previous-year sales. Sales performance is also reported by fiscal year.

name: Sales Quota
description: The sales target set for a sales person over a period, kept as a history so that sales performance can be tracked against it over time.

name: Sales Territory
description: A geographic area in which Adventure Works sells its products, assigned to customers and sales people. The history of sales representatives' transfers between territories is part of the concept.

name: Sales Reason
description: A reason a customer gave for purchasing, such as a promotion, price or review. A sales order can be linked to one or more sales reasons.

name: Special Offer
description: A sale discount offered on products for a period of time. Which products an offer applies to is part of the concept.

name: Sales Tax Rate
description: The tax rate applied to sales in a state or province.

name: Currency
description: A standard ISO currency in which Adventure Works can sell. The currencies used in each country or region are part of the concept.

name: Currency Exchange Rate
description: The rate at which one currency converts into another on a given date, used when pricing sales orders in foreign currencies.

name: Credit Card
description: A customer's credit card used to pay for sales orders. Which people hold which cards is part of the concept.

name: Shopping Cart Item
description: A product an online customer has placed in a shopping cart. Items are held until the order is submitted or cancelled.
